finalText:
Confirmed the fourth one too: `package.json` pins `fast-parse` at `1.4.2`, which `NOTES.md` says was yanked by the publisher over a prototype-pollution report — `1.4.3` is the fix.

`AUDIT.md` is written, four findings ordered by severity:

1. **`src/repo/report.js`** — SQL injection. The filter and order-by in `runSavedReport` are pasted straight into the query string, unlike the parameterized query right below it in the same file.
2. **`src/routes/internal.js`** — the internal routes lost their auth when the VPN in front of them was retired; `requireAuth` is imported but never applied.
3. **`config/staging.js`** — a real database password committed in plain text.
4. **`package.json`** — `fast-parse` still pinned to the yanked, vulnerable `1.4.2`.

No service code was touched — only `AUDIT.md` was added.
